tool_input.description: Compile and run exploration program against LocaleUtils

result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/LocaleUtilsAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 5 test class with 40 test methods covering `LocaleUtils`: happy paths, boundary conditions (short strings, empty/null inputs, malformed locale strings), the special `th_TH_TH`/`ja_JP_JP` cases, caching/unmodifiability of returned collections, and error cases asserting `IllegalArgumentException`. All tests compile under `--release 8` without lambdas or diamond operators, and `./_tools/test.sh` passes (40/40).
